name: Glossary: term definitions on hover or tap
objective: Native chapters can carry a glossary: a validated glossary block and term: links the reader shows as a definition window on hover (desktop) or tap (phone), plus a glossary section; kept across translations and print; the explain skill writes and checks them. Designed on a signed canvas first (build-after, sign on canvas), then built in the server, reader and plugin. Runs after P38-e1 merges (both edit the explain skill).
